page.overview:
What is Fanghu Mountain?

Fanghu Mountain is an incredibly tall mountain rising out of the East Sea. On top of it is an immortal palace with purple towers which illuminate the three pure paths. Floral-scented, five-colour mist flows up from it. The area is inhabited by golden phoenixes, as well as peach and plum trees.
